Gladsaxe is a Danish municipality that appears in the provided corpus solely as a geographic data point in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. 

In the context of the report, Gladsaxe's data regarding stroke (apopleksi) events among patients with atrial fibrillation is included in the calculations for Indicator 5 [^src1]. This specific indicator measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AK) treatment, utilizing data from both the DanStroke registry and the National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. The report breaks down these clinical quality metrics across all 98 Danish municipalities to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Gladsaxe is listed in the tabular data for Indicator 5 on page 93, alongside its specific statistical metrics for the reporting period [^src1]. 

Because the available data is extremely thin, no further details, relationships, or historical timeline events regarding Gladsaxe are documented in this corpus.
